meta.name: competitor-teardown
meta.description: Structured competitive analysis with feature matrices, SWOT, positioning maps, and UX review. Covers research frameworks, pricing comparison, review mining, and visual deliverables. Use for: market research, competitive intelligence, investor decks, product strategy, sales enablement. Triggers: competitor analysis, competitive analysis, competitor teardown, market research, competitive intelligence, swot analysis, competitor comparison, market landscape, competitor review, competitive landscape, feature comparison, market positioning

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞品并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统分析竞争对手并输出可视化报告
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitors and generate structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze competitors and produce visual deliverables

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能进行结构化竞品分析，包括功能矩阵、SWOT、定位图和用户评论挖掘。它会使用命令行工具搜索信息、截取竞品网站截图，并生成对比报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“竞品分析”、“市场调研”、“SWOT分析”等关键词，或要求比较产品、分析市场格局时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份Notion和Asana的竞品分析。
say.note: Claude 会搜索信息并生成结构化报告。

say.text: 分析一下竞品A的定价策略和用户评价。
say.note: Claude 会提取定价页面和G2评论。

say.text: 生成一个竞品定位图，横轴是简单到复杂，纵轴是SMB到企业。
say.note: Claude 会调用Python绘制并保存图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform structured competitive analysis including feature matrices, SWOT, positioning maps, and user review mining. It uses CLI tools to search information, take screenshots of competitor websites, and generate comparison reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "competitor analysis", "market research", "SWOT analysis", or ask to compare products or analyze market landscape.

say_en.text: Do a competitive teardown of Notion vs Asana.
say_en.note: Claude will search and generate a structured report.

say_en.text: Analyze Competitor A's pricing and user reviews.
say_en.note: Claude will extract pricing page and G2 reviews.

say_en.text: Generate a positioning map with axes simple-complex and SMB-enterprise.
say_en.note: Claude will use Python to plot and save the image.
